title: Bounce

title: Bump!
description: Bump! is a puzzle and adventure game by st33d. The developer's README describes the repository as the source code for Bump!
controls: Q-W-E-A-S-D to move, R to restart, click to play.

license.notes: MIT (LICENSE) and GPL-3.0 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/st33d/bump/master/licence.txt). Source: https://github.com/st33d/bump. Corresponding source available at the repository above.

title: Red Rogue
description: Red Rogue is a platformer-roguelike written in Flex and compiled with FlashDevelop.

license.notes: Source: https://github.com/st33d/red-rogue. Corresponding source available at the repository above.

title: Star Catch
description: An old, addictive and very hard Macromedia Flash game, made in 2013 and playable again in the Ruffle emulator. Click on all the objects you see.
controls: Click on the objects. Keys: F full-screen, H/M/L quality, P pause, Q quit, S stop music.

license.notes: Copyright (c) 2013-2025 Mhatxotic Design. Source: https://github.com/Mhatxotic/StarCatch. Developer README lists Ruffle limitations: title and stage music do not loop; score display and quality/full-screen keys may not work. Stage size 640x480 read from Ruffle metadata (SWF is ZWS/LZMA, header not parsed).

title: Sweet Smash
description: Sweet Smash is a puzzle game written in ActionScript 3.0. Swap neighbouring sweets to make rows or columns of three or more matching sweets.

license.notes: Original programming and artwork by Matthew Farmer. Source: https://github.com/mfarmer/sweet-smash. Corresponding source available at the repository above. Developer README labels the game Beta.
